# Pakistan OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **13 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Pakistan ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Pakistan national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Pakistan public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Pakistan in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 37,603,000 |
| Lines / route length | 56 / 1,673 km |
| Fleet | 2,461 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $15.53 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $11.80 B (76%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 217.1 MW / 1298.0 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $24.22 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
